strongest_angle: The October 29, 2026 recall of 5.9 million Bodum French press coffee makers highlights critical safety risks associated with replaceable glass carafes, impacting eight distinct product models.

key_facts.fact: On October 29, 2026, the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission announced a recall of 5.9 million Bodum French press coffee makers.
The recall involves eight specific models of Bodum coffee makers that feature replaceable glass carafes.
Bodum USA initiated this voluntary recall due to the risk of the glass carafe breaking during use, which can lead to serious burn injuries.
